api.addTranslations: Merges new keys into a locale map at runtime.
api.availableLocales: Lists locales with a loaded translation map.
api.has: Checks whether a key exists, optionally in another locale.
api.normalizeLocale: Maps pt, en-GB or es-MX style tags to pt-BR, en-US, es-419.
api.resetLocale: Clears the explicit choice and the stored value.
api.setLocale: Normalizes, persists and activates a locale.
api.translate: Looks up a key with interpolation (alias: instant).

translate.description: Runtime translation for component text and dynamic content. The active locale is a signal: every template using the translate pipe re-renders with no reload.

section.apiDesc: Public surface of SolarisTranslateService plus the provider configuration.
section.fallbackDesc: Missing keys resolve through locale, fallbackLocale, en-US, an optional resolver, then the raw key. The sentence below only exists in en-US, so it renders in English on every locale.
section.interpolationDesc: Parameters use {{name}} with optional spaces. There is no ICU plural yet: the convention is .singular / .plural keys with {{count}}.
section.localeDesc: Pick a locale. setLocale() normalizes, persists and notifies every translate pipe.
section.runtimeDesc: Pages can register keys after load, e.g. for lazy content. The button registers translate.demo.custom for the current locale.

translate.title: Translation service
translate.useWhen: Use the service for component-level text, dynamic content and quick locale switching. It does not replace @angular/localize for static extraction workflows.
